title: Two-step verification
unavailable: Two-step verification is not available for this account at the moment.
off.intro: Once enabled, you sign in to webmail with your password and a one-time code from an app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Bitwarden).
off.devices: Mail programs (Thunderbird, Outlook, Apple Mail, your phone) get their own device passwords, which you create on this page. Your regular password will stop working in them.
enroll.scan: 1. Scan the code with your app
enroll.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app manually:
enroll.enter: 2. Enter the code from the app
on.hint: Webmail sign-in: after your password, a window asks for the 6 digits from the app. When you change your password in the mail settings, enter the current password immediately followed by the code, without spaces.
backup.title: Backup codes
backup.intro: No phone at hand? Enter one of the backup codes in the code window instead of the code from the app. Each code works once.
backup.save: Store these codes somewhere safe (password manager, printout). You will see them only now.
backup.voids: New codes invalidate all previous ones.
devices.title: Device passwords
devices.intro: Every mail program and phone gets its own password. Remove a lost device from the list; the others keep working.
devices.label: e.g. Thunderbird – laptop
devices.newHint: — enter it in the program instead of your regular password.
devices.onlyNow: You will see it only now.
disable.title: Turn off two-step verification
disable.intro: Also removes all device passwords and backup codes — mail programs will need your regular password again.
msg.enabled: Two-step verification is on. Save the backup codes below, then create passwords for your mail programs — your regular password no longer works in them.
msg.newCodes: New backup codes generated. Save them now.
confirm.remove: Remove the password of “{label}”? That program will stop receiving mail.
confirm.newCodes: Generate new codes? All current codes will stop working.
confirm.disable: Turn off two-step verification and remove all device passwords?
err.invalid_code: Wrong or expired code. Enter the current code from the app or a backup code.
err.code_used: This code has already been used. Wait for the app to show a new one.
err.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 10 minutes.
err.qr_expired: The QR code has expired. Start again.
err.bad_label: Device name: 1–40 characters — letters, digits, space, dot, underscore, hyphen.
err.label_taken: A device with this name already exists.
err.unavailable: Two-step verification is not available for your domain.
err.load: Could not load the current status.
err.too_many_devices: Device limit reached. Remove a device you no longer use.
unavailable.not_enabled: Your administrator has not enabled it for this domain.
unavailable.fallback: Administrator: set zimbraAuthFallbackToLocal to FALSE for this domain.
unavailable.admin_mech: Administrator: zimbraAuthMechAdmin of this domain uses another mechanism.
login.title: Two-step verification
login.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from the authenticator app on your phone.
login.noTwoFactor: I have not turned on two-step verification — sign in without a code
login.hint: No phone at hand? Enter one of your backup codes instead.
unavailable.not_offered: Your administrator has not made it available for this account.
err.required: Two-step verification is required for this account. You can set it up again, but only your administrator can turn it off.
login.retryIntro: The password alone was not accepted. If you use two-step verification, enter the 6-digit code from your app. If not, cancel and check your password.
required.title: Two-step verification is required
required.intro: Your administrator requires it for your account. Set it up below and save your backup codes, then continue to mail.
rekey.title: New phone
rekey.intro: Two-step verification is required for this account. After changing phones, set it up again: the old app entry and backup codes stop working, device passwords stay.
off.recovery: Turning it on turns off Carbonio's built-in password recovery, whose mailed code signs in without the second factor. You recover a forgotten password yourself: with a code sent to your recovery address and the code from the app (or a backup code) – the “Forgot your password?” link under the login screen.
recovery.warn: Password recovery by a code sent to your recovery address is turned on for your account. Such a code signs in without the second factor, so it weakens two-step verification. If this was not intended, ask your administrator to turn recovery off.
admin.title: Two-step verification – administration
admin.domains.intro: Off: Carbonio sign-in as usual. Active: works for accounts given access below. Available to all: every account may turn it on. Required for all: every account must set it up at the next webmail sign-in.
admin.accounts.intro: “Inherit” takes the value from the class of service and the domain setting. Account status comes from Carbonio; Carbonio records the last sign-in at most once a day. Reset removes the secret, device passwords and backup codes – for a lost phone and codes.
admin.warn.fallback: zimbraAuthFallbackToLocal=TRUE – the second factor can be skipped.
admin.warn.recoveryOn: Password recovery turned on for {account}. The account has two-step verification, which this weakens: a code from the recovery address signs in without the second factor. The user sees a warning on their 2FA page.
admin.confirm.off: Turn two-step verification off for {domain}? Accounts that have it will sign in with the password alone; their settings stay and return when it is turned on again.
admin.confirm.requiredDomain: Require two-step verification from every account of {domain}? Everyone will have to set it up at their next webmail sign-in.
admin.confirm.required: Require two-step verification from {account}? It will have to be set up at the next webmail sign-in.
admin.confirm.recovery: {account} has two-step verification. Turning password recovery on weakens it: a code sent to the recovery address signs in without the second factor. Turn it on anyway?
admin.confirm.reset: Reset two-step verification of {account}? Removes the secret, every device password and the backup codes; mail programs will need to be set up again.
admin.shown: Accounts shown: {shown} of {total}. Click a heading to sort; an account address opens the domain's accounts in the Carbonio admin console.
admin.openInConsole: Open the domain's accounts in the Carbonio admin console (account details: click it in the list)
login.recover: Forgot your password? Recovery for accounts with two-step verification
address.title: Password recovery address
address.intro: If you forget your password, we send a code to this address. Changing the password takes this code and the code from the app (or a backup code). Use an address outside this mailbox, such as a private one.
address.sent: We sent a code to {address}. Enter it below (valid for 30 minutes).
err.bad_address: Enter a valid e-mail address other than this mailbox.
err.mail_limit: A code was sent a moment ago. Try again in a minute.
err.invalid_mail_code: Wrong or expired code from the e-mail.
recover.title: Password recovery
recover.step1.intro: For accounts with two-step verification and a confirmed recovery address. We send a code to that address.
recover.step2.intro: Enter the code from the e-mail, the 6 digits from your authenticator app (or one of your backup codes) and a new password.
recover.sent: If the account has two-step verification and a confirmed recovery address, we sent a code valid for 15 minutes to it. Check the spam folder too.
recover.code: Code from the app or a backup code
recover.done.intro: Sign in with the new password and the code from the app. Device passwords in mail programs keep working.
recover.err.invalid_mail_code: Wrong or expired code from the e-mail. After five mistakes or 15 minutes, ask for a new one.
recover.err.password_policy: The new password does not meet the server's rules.
mail.code.subject: Code to change your password
mail.code.body:
Someone asked to change the password of the mailbox {account}.

Code: {code}

The code is valid for {minutes} minutes. Changing the password also takes the code from the authenticator app.
If this was not you, ignore this message – without the code from the app the password cannot be changed.
mail.changed.subject: Your password was changed
mail.changed.body:
The password of the mailbox {account} was changed by recovery (code from the e-mail and code from the app), from {ip}.

If this was not you, contact your administrator at once.
mail.verify.subject: Confirm your password recovery address
login.recoverIntro: Carbonio's built-in recovery is not available for this account. If you use two-step verification, recover your password with a code from your recovery address and the code from your app.
channels.title: Codes by SMS and e-mail
channels.intro: Besides the app, the sign-in window can send a code by SMS or to your recovery address. Turn on the channels you want to use. Each code works once, within 5 minutes.
channels.smsSent: We sent an SMS to {phone}. Enter the code below (valid for 10 minutes).
channels.smsSaved: Phone number saved. The sign-in window can now send you a code by SMS.
channels.smsUnavailable: Codes by SMS are not configured on this server.
channels.emailIntro: The code goes to your password recovery address. Use it only for an address that you alone can read.
channels.emailOn: Send codes to the recovery address
channels.emailNeedsAddress: Set and confirm a password recovery address first (section below).
channels.emailOnMsg: The sign-in window can now send you a code to the recovery address.
confirm.phoneRemove: Remove the phone number? The sign-in window will stop offering codes by SMS.
err.sms_unavailable: Codes by SMS are not configured on this server.
err.invalid_sms_code: Wrong or expired code from the SMS.
err.address_first: Set and confirm a password recovery address first.
login.sent: If this channel is set up for your account, the code is on its way. Enter it above.
login.sendNeedsPassword: Enter your password in the sign-in form first.
mail.login.subject: Sign-in code
mail.login.body:
Sign-in code for the mailbox {account}: {code}

The code is valid for {minutes} minutes and works once. Someone who asked for it already knows the password of this mailbox: if this was not you, change the password and contact your administrator.
sms.login: Sign-in code for {account}: {code}. Valid {minutes} min. If you did not ask for it, change your password.
sms.verify: Code confirming this number for {account}: {code}. Valid {minutes} min.
channels.password: Mailbox password (needed to add a channel)
err.phone_country: Codes by SMS are available for numbers in the countries allowed on this server.
err.address_local: The recovery address is on this mail server. Codes by e-mail need an address outside it, such as a private one.
admin.sms.title: SMS gateways
admin.sms.intro: Codes by SMS go through the gateway of the user's domain: its own one (domain.<domain>.sms.* in the file) or the default one. A domain sends SMS only with its box ticked above. The configuration is edited in the file on the server (root:zextras 0640); the page only shows it. The token is never shown.
admin.sms.state.unreadable: present, but the mailbox cannot read it (owner must be root:zextras) — SMS off
admin.sms.testPhone: Phone number for the test SMS
admin.err.sms_gateway: The SMS gateway refused the request.
admin.err.phone_country: This gateway does not allow numbers from this country (sms.countries).
admin.err.mail_limit: A test SMS was sent a moment ago. Try again in a minute.
